points: 140 CVEs from AI research between May and September, 52 of them in September
155 validated reports sent to 23 open-source projects; about 60% acknowledged so far
Advice to security leaders: count validated fixes, not findings
take: Finding bugs is now cheap, about $3.61 per crash proof. Checking and fixing them is the real limit.
title: Microsoft: AI found 140 Windows flaws in five months
